caption: Office workout at your desk: five moves in the gap between meetings. No floor work, no changing, no sweat, standing and chair work only. Save it for tomorrow's calendar.

voiceover.text: Your two o'clock ended early. The next starts at three.
That gap is a full session. Standing and chair work only, in the clothes you are wearing.
Wall push-ups. Ten reps. Any clear stretch of wall.
Wall slides. Ten reps. Back on the wall, arms slide up and down.
Sit-to-stands from your chair. Eight reps. No hands.
Standing hip hinges. Ten reps. Hips back, flat back, stand tall.
Seated knee lifts. Ten reps. Sit tall, lift slow.
Back at your desk before anyone notices. How long is your usual gap? Comment the minutes.
